The Technology Laboratory (Tech Lab) at Zaha Hadid Architects is a cultural fixture and amenity located in the heart of London. It serves as a multidisciplinary design incubator for technology and the arts. 

The lab, along with its adjoining workshop, aims to commercialize and accelerate design experimentation and digital craft in the creative industries.
